response.sql:
WITH per_account AS (
  SELECT a.account_id AS account_number, a.frequency AS frequency, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_amount
  FROM trans t
  JOIN account a ON a.account_id = t.account_id
  GROUP BY a.account_id, a.frequency
)
SELECT account_number, frequency, avg_amount,
       avg_amount / AVG(avg_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY frequency) AS ratio
FROM per_account
ORDER BY (ratio IS NULL), ratio DESC, account_number
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Account number means account.account_id. Transactions belonging to an existing account are those that join to account (inner join).

The average uses trans.amount as stored (unsigned), with no sign applied by trans.type. The request says 'transaction amount', and the direction of VYBER rows is undocumented, so signing would require a guess.

The ratio's denominator is the plain, unweighted mean of per-account averages within the same frequency, so each account counts equally. A NULL ratio (zero mean) sorts last. Ties break by account_number.
